A little about this tool.

Your CV is read in your browser and cleared on reload. Saved job IDs stay on this device.

The CV check uses local rules to spot section headings, contact details, date patterns and examples of impact. It can miss things or flag text that is fine. It does not assess employability, writing quality or ATS compatibility. No AI service receives your text.

Roles come from Remotive, Arbeitnow, Himalayas, We Work Remotely, Startup Jobs, Remote OK, Jobicy and selected employers’ Greenhouse, Ashby and Lever boards. Matching uses shared skill keywords, title relevance and your preferences, not an AI assessment. We show up to five results. “Not for me” hides that listing and gently lowers similar titles, levels or locations depending on your reason. Feedback and saved IDs stay on this browser. Reset feedback below to start fresh. Review skills to adjust your matches.

Location is a guide. Check each listing for work eligibility and restrictions. Arbeitnow focuses on Europe; Remotive listings are delayed by 24 hours.

Text-based PDFs, DOCX and TXT are supported, up to 10 MB. For scanned PDFs, paste the text.

Recognised past closing dates are hidden. Older listings are hidden unless an employer’s current public board confirms they remain listed. Source failures do not mean a role is closed. Feed checks confirm that a job was returned by a source, not that an employer is still accepting applications. Ambiguous dates are left for you to verify.

Duplicate listings are combined, with source links in the job details. Recent-job feeds are partial: disappearing from one does not prove a job has closed.

X and Wellfound are not connected. X search needs developer credentials. You can also browse Wellfound and Y Combinator startup jobs.
